name: conductor-sessions
description: Pause and resume the coding-agent sessions running in your terminals, from VS Code. Companion to the `conductor` CLI: reopens paused Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode sessions in integrated terminals.

conductor.cliPath.description: Path to the conductor CLI binary.

conductor.stateDir.description: Conductor state directory (the CLI's CONDUCTOR_STATE_DIR). Leave empty for the default, ~/.conductor.
